items.name: williamsburg
items.title: Williamsburg tokens
items.description: Design tokens for Williamsburg sections: Williamsburg is a loud, editorial store for one product: huge black uppercase "wall" titles, full-bleed tile grids split by 1px gaps, products on flat warm grey tiles, and flash-lit night photography with text laid over it. When you build new UI here, it should be indistinguishable from the existing pages. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-about-hero
items.title: Williamsburg Hero
items.description: Full-bleed photo hero at hero height with a bottom gradient and a huge uppercase wall title in light text, a short inline note set beside the last word. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-about-process
items.title: Williamsburg Process
items.description: Process steps: wall title with an inline note, then a full-bleed four column gap-px grid of tall photo tiles, each with a gradient, step number and short uppercase caption. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-about-story
items.title: Williamsburg Story
items.description: Story block on a muted ground: wall title across the full width, then two columns of small indented body copy in the right half. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-about-team
items.title: Williamsburg Team
items.description: Team grid: wall title with an inline note, then a full-bleed gap-px grid of square portraits on surface tiles, each with name, role and a Since year in uppercase captions. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-cart-cart-drawer
items.title: Williamsburg CartDrawer
items.description: Right-side cart dialog opened by data-cart-open: line items rendered from localStorage with quantity steppers, an empty state, subtotal and a Checkout button; pairs with data-add-to-cart buttons. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-cart-cart-items
items.title: Williamsburg CartItems
items.description: Cart page: wall title with a pair count note and Keep shopping link, a full-bleed gap-px grid of product tiles with quantity steppers and Remove, and a summary tile with a large total and Checkout. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-checkout-checkout
items.title: Williamsburg Checkout
items.description: Full-screen checkout split in two: logo, wall title and a four step form (contact, shipping, delivery radio tiles, payment) on the left, a sticky order summary with product tiles and total on the right. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-contact-hero
items.title: Williamsburg Hero
items.description: Contact page: wall title with an inline note, then a full-bleed two column gap-px split, contact channel tiles with large values on one side and a surface tile with workshop details and a message form on the other. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-help-help-article
items.title: Williamsburg HelpArticle
items.description: Help article: wall title with the topic description as its note and an All topics link, then a sticky topic nav in the first column and prose across the other two. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-help-help-index
items.title: Williamsburg HelpIndex
items.description: Help center index: wall title with a note and a Write to the workshop link, then a full-bleed gap-px grid of surface tiles, each with a topic title, description and its question links. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-journal-journal-index
items.title: Williamsburg JournalIndex
items.description: Journal index: wall title with a note, then full-bleed rows split in three, a surface tile with author, date, large title and description across two columns and a 4/3 photo in the third. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-journal-more-posts
items.title: Williamsburg MorePosts
items.description: Latest posts: wall title with an optional note and an All notes link, then a full-bleed gap-px row of two or three tall photo journal cards. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-journal-post-body
items.title: Williamsburg PostBody
items.description: Post body: sticky author block with avatar, date and reading time in the first column, prose across the other two. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-journal-post-hero
items.title: Williamsburg PostHero
items.description: Post hero: huge wall title with the description as its note and an All notes link, then a full-bleed cover photo at peek height. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-boot-wall
items.title: Williamsburg BootWall
items.description: Product wall: wall title with a note and a Shop all link, then a full-bleed five column gap-px grid of square surface tiles, one cutout product per tile. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-departments
items.title: Williamsburg Departments
items.description: Two departments: wall title with a note and a Shop all link, then a full-bleed two column gap-px grid of tall surface tiles with a large cutout product, name, description and a pair count. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-hero
items.title: Williamsburg Hero
items.description: Full-screen photo hero with top and bottom gradients and a huge uppercase wall title in light text at the bottom, a short inline note beside the last word. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-new-arrivals
items.title: Williamsburg NewArrivals
items.description: Product grid with an editorial photo: wall title with a note and a Shop all link, then a full-bleed four column gap-px grid where a large photo spans half and four product cards fill the rest; can flip sides. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-reviews
items.title: Williamsburg Reviews
items.description: Single review: wall title with a note, then a full-screen portrait with a gradient, a large pull quote in light text and the reviewer's name and pair linked below. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-landing-statement
items.title: Williamsburg Statement
items.description: Statement on a muted ground: a huge uppercase wall sentence with two small inline notes set between its words, one Shop all boots button, then a wide full-width photo below. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-legal-legal-document
items.title: Williamsburg LegalDocument
items.description: Legal page: wall title with an Updated date note and links to the other documents, then a sticky On this page list in the first column and prose across the other two. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-products-product-hero
items.title: Williamsburg ProductHero
items.description: Product page hero: swipeable image slider across two columns with a thumbnail strip and arrows, title, summary, price, size picker, Add to cart and a Details trigger in the first column. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-products-product-reviews
items.title: Williamsburg ProductReviews
items.description: Review slider: wall title with a note, a count and previous and next buttons, then a full-bleed split of the reviewed product on a surface tile and a large quote with an avatar caption. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-products-product-testimonial
items.title: Williamsburg ProductTestimonial
items.description: Full-screen testimonial: portrait photo with a gradient, a large pull quote in light text and the customer's name and boot below. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-products-related
items.title: Williamsburg Related
items.description: Related products: wall title with a note and a Shop all link, then a full-bleed five column gap-px grid of square surface tiles with cutout products. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-shop-catalogue
items.title: Williamsburg Catalogue
items.description: Shop catalogue: wall title with a note, department buttons with counts and text sort controls, then a full-bleed four column gap-px grid of product cards that re-sorts client side. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: williamsburg-system-buttons
items.title: Williamsburg Buttons

items.name: williamsburg-system-colors

items.name: williamsburg-system-links

items.title: Williamsburg Typography

items.name: zeroindex
items.title: ZeroIndex tokens
items.description: Design tokens for ZeroIndex sections: ZeroIndex is a documentation-first SaaS theme: quiet, technical, and utilitarian. Small restrained type, hairline borders, pill-shaped controls, monospace meta labels, and full light/dark support. New UI should be indistinguishable from the existing docs shell and landing sections. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: zeroindex-landing-gettin-started
items.title: ZeroIndex GettinStarted
items.description: Docs scale heading and lead paragraph, then four plain text feature columns in a 1/2/4 grid, each with title, description and a chevron link, no cards or images. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: zeroindex-landing-hero
items.title: ZeroIndex Hero
items.description: Documentation hero on a tinted band: shared Header block with title and one-paragraph description, then two small buttons, accent and muted, in a row. Needs a Lexington MCP key.

items.name: zeroindex-landing-resources
items.title: ZeroIndex Resources
items.description: Three column split: heading and lead paragraph in column one, four soft rounded resource cards with title, description and chevron link in a two column grid spanning the rest. Needs a Lexington MCP key.
